core.map.classifyHint: How grade values are split into colour bands. Quantile puts an equal COUNT of holes in each colour regardless of skew -- the right choice for grade data, which is almost never evenly spread. Equal interval splits the raw range instead, which on a skewed distribution can put over 90% of holes in one colour.

tour.p1.s1.title: Welcome to Orebit Core!
tour.p1.s1.body: This tool helps you prepare drilling data (collar, survey, assay, geology) before EDA or GeoSuite Resource. 3-stage pipeline: P1 → P2 → P3.
tour.p1.s2.title: Thalanga demo loaded
tour.p1.s2.body: Sample data: 717 holes · 10,018 assays ready. The yellow banner above will disappear automatically when you upload your own data.
tour.p1.s3.title: <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="17 8 12 3 7 8"/><line x1="12" y1="3" x2="12" y2="15"/></svg> Import tab
tour.p1.s3.body: Upload 4 CSV files: collar.csv, survey.csv, assay.csv, geology.csv. Columns are auto-detected (semicolon CSV + comma decimals also supported).
tour.p1.s4.title: Validation tab
tour.p1.s4.body: Quick Insight at the top of this tab gives an instant summary: linkage clean, completeness %, BDL%, gaps. Green = ready to continue, yellow = has notes, red = fix first.
tour.p1.s5.title: Merge tab + <svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M21 15v4a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H5a2 2 0 0 1-2-2v-4"/><polyline points="7 10 12 15 17 10"/><line x1="12" y1="15" x2="12" y2="3"/></svg> Export
tour.p1.s5.body: After Desurvey (Tab 10), merge the 4 tables into a master file (Tab 11), then export a P2-ready CSV (Tab 12). A schema header is added automatically.

tour.p1.s6.body: Buttons in the top-right: Glossary (search terms), Tour (replay this guide), Theme (light/dark). You can replay the tour anytime.
